name: gamedna-monorepo
description: GameDNA: a Kiro Power and local MCP toolset for evidence-driven game refinement.

scripts.build: npm run build:workbench && npm run build:power && npm run build:apps
scripts.build:apps: npm run build -w gravity-shift && npm run build -w neon-survivor
scripts.assets: npm run assets -w gravity-shift && npm run assets -w neon-survivor
scripts.check:power: npm run build:workbench && npm run build:power && git diff --exit-code -- power/server
